neighbours.label: a verb of design or success that heads a purpose/result complement (designed to, succeeded in, intended to)
fire: The program was designed to help veterans find work.
After years of effort, the team succeeded in mapping the genome.
Laws were passed, designed to keep migrants out of the cities.
The engineers succeeded in lowering the bridge's weight.
This valve is designed to release pressure slowly.
She has succeeded in turning a small shop into a chain.
The policy, designed to curb inflation, raised interest rates.
Rebels succeeded in capturing the northern airport.
quiet: The program was started last year in three cities.
After years of effort, the team published the genome.
Laws were passed, and migrants left the cities.
The engineers lowered the bridge's weight by a third.
This valve releases pressure slowly when opened.
She has turned a small shop into a chain.
The policy raised interest rates in the spring.
Rebels captured the northern airport at dawn.

notes: Arabic 'min sha'nihā an' (capable of) is the top example. Probe: designed 0.34-0.5, succeeded 0.56, managed/calculated/intended only 0.1-0.2, so the test leans on designed/succeeded.
